---
title: "Publications"
description: "Douglas Fritz's journal articles, newest first, with their authors, journal, status, research pillars and topic tags, and links to the DOI or publisher page and to any preprint."
# Card titles are not sections: no "#" anchor links on them.
anchor-sections: false
include-in-header:
  text: <script type="module" src="../js/archive-filters.js"></script>
listing:
  id: publications
  contents: ../data/generated/publications.yml
  template: ../templates/publication.ejs.md
  # Keep the generated order (year, newest first, then title) and render every
  # record: no Quarto sorting, paging, filtering, categories or feed. The
  # template has no `.list` element, so Quarto's list.js never attaches;
  # js/archive-filters.js does the filtering.
  sort: false
  page-size: 100000
  filter-ui: false
  sort-ui: false
  categories: false
  feed: false
  template-params:
    # Canonical pillar order (R/config.R); sets each pillar's number.
    pillars:
      - "Infectious-disease biology, evolution and environment"
      - "Quantitative and experimental biomedical discovery"
      - "Clinical translation and health-system improvement"
      - "Climate and planetary health in medicine"
---

Every entry shows its exact status. Entries marked **In Review** are manuscripts still under peer review: they are not published work.
